english.title: Driver of a motor vehicle fail to give owner name / address / produce test cert after road accident / offence
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a person

(A)_[driving a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_
(B)_[whom a constable had reasonable cause to believe to have been the driver of a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), at a time when an accident occurred owing to its presence,]_
(C)_[whom a constable had reasonable cause to believe to have committed an offence in relation to the use of a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_

on a road namely, **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), on being so required by a constable, failed to give the name and address of the owner of the vehicle and to produce for examination a test certificate issued in respect of the vehicle
english.legislation: Contrary to section 165(3) of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to theRoad Traffic Offenders Act 1988.

english.notes:
(i) This offence wording relates to motor vehicles other than invalid carriages.
(ii) Statement of facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
(iii) See section 165(2)(c) for requirements re production of goods vehicle plating certificate and test certificate
english.standardstatementoffacts:
At **(..SPECIFY TIME..) on **(..SPECIFY DATE..) the defendant was

(A)_[the driver of **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..)]_
(B)_[suspected of being the driver of **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..) when an accident occurred owing its presence]_
(C)_[suspected of committing an offence in relation to the use of **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..)]_

on **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..). The defendant failed to give the name and address of the vehicle's owner to a police constable when requested to do so and failed to produce for examination a test certificate in respect of the vehicle, when requested to do so, either then or within seven days thereafter.

welsh.welshoffencetitle: Gyrrwr cerbyd modur yn methu rhoi enw/cyfeiriad y perchennog/cyflwyno tystysgrif prawf ar ôl trosedd/damwain ar y fford
welsh.welshstandardoffencewording:
Ar **(..SPECIFY DATE..) yn **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) a chithau'n unigolyn

(A)_[a oedd yn gyrru cerbyd modur, sef **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_
(B)_[yr oedd gan gwnstabl achos rhesymol dros gredu mai chi oedd yn gyrru cerbyd modur, sef **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), ar adeg pan ddigwyddodd damwain oherwydd ei bresenoldeb]_
(C)_[yr oedd gan gwnstabl achos rhesymol dros gredu eich bod wedi cyflawni trosedd yng nghyswllt defnyddio cerbyd modur, sef **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..)]_

ar ffordd, sef **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), pan ofynnodd gwnstabl i chi wneud hynny, bu i chi fethu rhoi enw a chyfeiriad perchennog y cerbyd, a chyflwyno ar gyfer ei harchwilio dystysgrif prawf yng nghyswllt y cerbyd.
welsh.welshstandardstatementoffacts:
Am **(..SPECIFY TIME..) ar **(..SPECIFY DATE..) roedd y diffynnydd

(A)_[yn gyrru **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_
(B)_[dan amheuaeth o fod yn gyrru **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), pan ddigwyddodd damwain oherwydd ei bresenoldeb]_
(C)_[dan amheuaeth o gyflawni trosedd yng nghyswllt defnyddio **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_

ar **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..). Methodd y diffynnydd i roi enw a chyfeiriad perchennog y cerbyd i gwnstabl yr heddlu pan ofynnwyd iddo/iddi wneud hynny, a methodd gyflwyno tystysgrif prawf berthnasol ar gyfer ei harchwilio yng nghyswllt y cerbyd, pan ofynnwyd iddo/iddi wneud hynny, naill ai ar y pryd neud o fewn saith diwrnod wedi hynny.
welsh.welshlegislation: Yn groes i adran 165(3) Deddf Traffig Ffyrdd 1988 ac Atodlen 2 Deddf Tramgwyddwyr Traffig Ffyrdd 1988.
